title: Don't sweat it
content: Meaning/Usage: To tell someone not to worry Explanation: When people worry a lot, they can sweat. This became a popular way to tell someone not to worry. "You can't do anything about it, so don't sweat it." "You tried your best, so stop sweating it." A: "I'm worried about my final examination." B: "You didn't take it yet?" A: "I took it yesterday. I'm not sure how I did." B: "If you tried your best, there's nothing you can do about the results, so don't sweat it." Other Common Sentences "Don't worry about it." "Nothing you can do about it."

examples.sentence: You can't do anything about it, so don't sweat it.
You tried your best, so stop sweating it.
I'm worried about my final examination.
I took it yesterday. I'm not sure how I did.
If you tried your best, there's nothing you can do about the results, so don't sweat it.
Nothing you can do about it.
